name: Irregular x End
source:
Esther is the disappointing daughter of a secretive occult family.

Esther is a NEET loser.

Esther has never touched a boob.

Esther is missing inside of her own home.

but only because no one wants to find her

One friend. One sister. One world.

Real feelings in a fake reality.

[From [url=https://melon-kid.itch.io/irregular-x-end]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
艾丝特是一个神秘玄学世家里不成器的女儿。

艾丝特是个废柴家里蹲。

艾丝特连女生的胸部都没摸过。

艾丝特在自己家里失踪了。

但那只是因为根本没人想去找她。

一个朋友。一个姐妹。一个世界。

虚假现实之中的真挚情感。
